root_cause: handleVisibilityChange in src/lib/auth/sessionExpiry.ts called refreshBffSession() every time the document became visible without checking the remaining access-token lifetime (recordedExpiresAtMs - Date.now()). Hosted BFF logs on 2026-11-04 recorded 11 POST /bff/auth/refresh 200 responses between 00:32:45Z and 00:35:54Z on a single login session, rotating credentials on every tab switch and increasing multi-tab collision risk.
fix: src/lib/auth/sessionExpiry.ts: in handleVisibilityChange, keep the existing renewalActive, document.visibilityState === 'visible', GCP Identity bearer token, and refresh-expired guards in order.

src/lib/auth/sessionExpiry.ts: after the refresh-expired check, when recordedExpiresAtMs is a finite number and recordedExpiresAtMs - Date.now() > DEFAULT_PROACTIVE_LEAD_MS (60_000), call scheduleProactiveRefresh() and return without sending POST /bff/auth/refresh.

src/lib/auth/sessionExpiry.ts: when recordedExpiresAtMs is within 60 seconds, already past, or unknown (null), call refreshBffSession() as before so single-flight renewal runs once and unknown expiry can be recorded from the response.
